description: The sound library: sound effects to add to an edit (footsteps, impacts, whooshes, ambiences, weather, crowds, animals, vehicles, doors, weapons, interface and game sounds, meme and hype hits…) from CC0 and public-domain packs, free to use in anything, and the community pack: sounds creators shared for free (their own recordings, beats, voice lines, effects), each vouched for by its sharer, not cuttingfloor. These are sounds to add, not sounds in the user's media (media.analyze sounds and media.listen find those). With query, a sound in words: the closest sounds first, matched on their names and tags and on how they sound; each says its similarity (0–1) and whether the words matched. Without query: the library by category, by popular (most used in edits this week) or newest. Both page with offset (next_offset) and filter by category, pack and length; the result lists every category and pack. Each sound's url is its file as its pack published it, for media.import; loudness_lufs and peak_dbtp are measured from it, and the level in the mix is yours. Where the chat app shows it, the result is a player in which the user can search, hear each sound and pick one; to let them hear particular sounds, list them by sound_ids.

category.description: Only sounds in this category (categories in the result lists them)

max_seconds.description: Only sounds this long or shorter

min_seconds.description: Only sounds this long or longer

offset.description: Where a page starts: the next_offset of the page before

order.description: Without query: category (by category, then name), popular (most used in edits over the last 7 days, then newest) or newest (latest added first)

pack.description: Only sounds from this pack (packs in the result lists them)

query.description: A sound in words ("footsteps on gravel", "a giant stomping", "rain on a window", "crowd cheering"): the closest sounds first, matched on their names and tags and on how they sound. Left out: the library in order (order).

sound_ids.description: Only these sounds, in this order (sound_id from an earlier result): to show the user particular sounds so they can hear them

name: sounds.list

categories.description: Every category in the library, with how many sounds it has

next_offset.description: offset for the next page; null on the last

note.description: Why a query was not searched, or searched only in part

packs.description: Every pack in the library, its licence and where it comes from

searched.description: true: sounds ranked by query, closest first. false: the library in order (no query, or the search could not run; note says why)

author.description: Who made it or, in the community pack, who shared it

description.description: What it is, as its pack describes it

keyword_match.description: Searched: whether query's words match its name, tags, category or description

licence.description: CC0 or public domain; in the community pack, "Shared by its uploader": a person shared it and vouches for it, not cuttingfloor

loudness_lufs.description: Integrated loudness of the file, measured

peak_dbtp.description: True peak of the file, measured

similarity.description: Searched: how close the sound is to query by how it sounds, 0–1 (CLAP); higher is closer

url.description: The file exactly as its pack published it (WAV, OGG, FLAC…), for media.import

uses.description: order popular: edits that used it in the last 7 days

total.description: Sounds that match the filters; null for a search, which ranks the closest 500

title: List and search sound effects
